title: Concept: Remote artifact added without integrity check in dockerfile — review required
description: In dockerfile, ADD pulls a remote URL into the image. The fetch happens at build time with no integrity metadata, so the artifact that lands in the layer is whatever the server returned then. A registry or host compromise therefore injects binaries or archives straight into the shipped image, and the Dockerfile gives no evidence of what was expected.
applicability: dockerfile images that fetch tools, archives, or certificates during build.
risk: Supply-chain injection into the built image; HIGH severity.
